To download the pair, load and edit both font sheets first.
Grid and marker pixels are protected. This replaces existing cells; it does not create new symbol indices or change XML. Keep original backups and update both font sizes for the same symbol.
How symbol indices work
Visual row/column labels here are navigation aids, not FontButtonIndex. Civ IV’s symbol order also depends on the font layout, padding and your mod’s definitions. Replace the symbol already assigned to your object, then test it in game. New resources or religions need matching XML and font allocation work.
The default fit leaves space around the symbol. At small sizes, a simple silhouette is clearer than a detailed photograph.


Ready. No installation or image upload required.

One resource per patchInstall and test the patch, then reload the updated folder before creating another. This avoids conflicting edits.
Drafts store settings and slot mappings. Reload artwork separately.

3 · Improvements, producers & consumers
Select multiple entries with Ctrl/Cmd-click. These lists edit direct resource connections; unrelated requirements are preserved.
New connections copy this template’s improvement bonus when present; otherwise they connect the resource with no extra improvement yield. Existing connection yields are preserved.Buildings already producing a different resource cannot be reassigned here.Existing alternative-resource requirements remain in effect. Entries with another mandatory resource are unavailable. Corporation inputs, special Python rules and building yield modifiers are outside this form.


4 · Button, map model & GameFont
No new artwork. The selected resource’s button is retained.
Register a slot once, then reuse its saved draft. Select matching cells at both sizes. The index cannot be inferred safely from a blank cell or visual row.
Without verification, the download is labelled TEST ONLY. Occupied indices are blocked. Test both font sizes and unrelated symbols before treating the slot as usable.


5 · Civilopedia & translationsEnglish is required. Empty translations use the English text and are identified in the change report. Existing translations are loaded when editing a resource.
